title: Azure VM Web Application Server
description: Ubuntu Linux virtual machine running Nginx with static public IP, guarded Network Security Group, and encrypted premium OS disk

server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Hostname and name prefix applied to the VM resources

resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: Existing resource group hosting the VM stack (typically an output of the Azure VNet template)

subnet_id.title: Subnet Resource ID
subnet_id.description: Azure Resource ID of the subnet to attach the VM NIC to (typically an output of the Azure VNet template)

location.title: Azure Region
location.description: Azure region where the VM resources will be deployed

allocated_storage_gb.title: OS Disk Storage (GB)
allocated_storage_gb.description: OS disk storage capacity in Gigabytes

admin_username.title: Admin Username
admin_username.description: Administrator login name for the Linux VM

admin_ssh_public_key.title: Admin SSH Public Key
admin_ssh_public_key.description: SSH public key (OpenSSH authorized_keys format) authorized for administrative access

allowed_ssh_cidr.title: Allowed SSH CIDR
allowed_ssh_cidr.description: Permitted IPv4 network block for SSH administrative access. Leave blank to disable inbound SSH.
